label: Set
cue: Hold a shoulder-width grip above your chest.

label: Lower
cue: Bend elbows; lower toward your upper chin.

label: Bottom
cue: Keep the bar above your throat.

label: Hold
cue: Stay supported; keep the bar controlled.

label: Extend
cue: Drive your elbows forward and up.

label: Finish
cue: Finish with both arms naturally extended.
